:::{#exr-cross-entropy-numeric-definition}

#### Cross-entropy of two mass functions from the definition

Let $p = (\tfrac{1}{2}, \tfrac{1}{4}, \tfrac{1}{4})$ and $q = (\tfrac{1}{4}, \tfrac{1}{2}, \tfrac{1}{4})$ be mass functions on $\set{1, 2, 3}$.
Compute the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $H(p, q)$ in bits from its definition.
If $X$ has mass function $p$, then $\E{-\log_2 q_X} = \tfrac{7}{4}$.
Compare this value with $H(p, q)$.

:::
